definitions.explanation: The act of yielding a point or making a compromise in a negotiation or argument. Implies making a sacrifice or giving up something to reach an agreement.

examples.japanese: {譲歩|じょうほ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧
⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{譲歩|じょうほ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{出|だ}した→引き出す：03002_hikidasu⟧。
examples.english: I managed to get a concession from the other party.

examples.japanese: ⟦{双方|そうほう}→双方：11859_souhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{譲歩|じょうほ}⟦しなければ→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{成立|せいりつ}しない→成立する：25497_seiritsusuru⟧。
examples.english: Unless both sides make concessions, the negotiations will not succeed.

notes:
USAGE: Used as a noun or with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to form the verb {譲歩|じょうほ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to make a concession, to compromise).

NUANCE: {譲歩|じょうほ} implies a deliberate decision to give ground or make sacrifices, typically in formal negotiations. It often appears in business and diplomatic contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {譲歩|じょうほ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to make a concession)
- {譲歩|じょうほ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧ (to demand a concession)
- {譲歩|じょうほ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{出|だ}す→引き出す：03002_hikidasu⟧ (to extract a concession)
- ⟦{相互|そうご}→相互：04045_sougo⟧{譲歩|じょうほ} (mutual compromise)
- ⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧な{譲歩|じょうほ} (significant concession)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{妥協|だきょう}→妥協：07423_dakyou⟧ (compromise - more general, everyday use)
- ⟦{折|お}り{合|あ}い→折り合い：09144_oriai⟧ (compromise, settlement)
- ⟦{歩|あゆ}み{寄|よ}り→歩み寄り：09145_ayumiyori⟧ (meeting halfway)
